Title: User registers with valid details and lands on account area
Preconditions: User is not registered; browser on Toolshop home
Test Steps:
1. Open Sign In
2. Navigate to Register
3. Fill all mandatory fields with valid data
4. Submit registration
Expected Result: Registration succeeds and user is signed in

Title: Registered user logs in successfully
Test Steps:
1. Open Sign In
2. Enter valid email/password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is authenticated and account menu is visible

Title: User adds multiple products and updates quantity in cart
Test Steps:
1. Open two different products
2. Add each to cart
3. Open cart and increase quantity of one item
Expected Result: Cart shows both products with updated quantity and subtotal

Title: Cash on Delivery checkout generates invoice after double confirm
Preconditions: Authenticated user with items in cart
Test Steps:
1. Proceed to checkout
2. Select Cash on Delivery
3. Press Confirm twice
4. Open My Invoices
Expected Result: Invoice is created and listed with invoice number

Title: Invalid login shows error and blocks access
Test Steps:
1. Open Sign In
2. Enter invalid credentials
3. Submit
Expected Result: Error message shown; user remains on login page

Title: Product search filters catalog by keyword
Test Steps:
1. Enter keyword (e.g. Pliers) in search
2. Submit search

Title: API register/login returns bearer token
Test Steps:
1. POST /users/register with valid payload
2. POST /users/login
3. Verify access_token present

Title: API invoice generation with valid cart and COD payload
Preconditions: Authenticated user with cart containing products
Test Steps:
1. POST /carts
2. POST /carts/{id} add product
3. POST /invoices with COD payload and cart_id
